value.rationale: The second vertex-induced forest stage of Q4 is a motivated uncomputed case in the established graph forest filtration, not a free parameter slice. Q4 is a canonical symmetric hypercube and periodic 4x4 grid. Its 14,911-face nonpure complex has 192 six-facets and 922 seven-facets yet the complete integral homotopy type is wedge129 S6, a substantial change from known earlier stages. Exact structural homotopy, not merely a face count, supplies a reusable benchmark for future filtration and graph-family investigations. No general or downstream theorem is required for this well-motivated exact finite classification.
